exactPrompt.heading: Lesson 04 — Dish re-shoot
exactPrompt.content:
Use this phone photo only as a reference for what our dish looks like. Now re-shoot this
same dish from scratch as a professional food photographer would, for our menu and
Instagram.
The dish: [describe it exactly — e.g. one normal single portion of masala Maggi on a round
steel plate with a steel fork] — exactly the ingredients you see in the reference, nothing
extra.
The new shot:
- Freshly plated, hot and glossy, with light natural steam rising
- Soft warm window light from the left, gentle shadows, rich appetising colours
- 45-degree food angle, close-up, shallow depth of field, sharp focus on the food
- Set on a clean warm wooden table, softly blurred cosy background
Do NOT add cheese, vegetables, coriander, egg or any garnish that is not in the reference.
Same portion size, not bigger. No text, no people. Must look like a real DSLR food photo,
not AI.

exactPrompt.heading: Lesson 02 — Step 1: Character design
exactPrompt.content:
I'm making a short animated cartoon series for Indian kids aged 3–8. Help me design the
two main characters.
1) [Character 1 — e.g. Golu, a 6-year-old Indian boy who lives in a small mohalla in an
Indian city]
2) [Character 2 — e.g. Chiku, Golu's pet squirrel and best friend]

simple Hindi, a simple outfit/look with exact colours, and face and body details. Keep the
look simple so AI can repeat it every time — plain clothes, no logos, no patterns, no text
on clothes.

exactPrompt.heading: Lesson 7 — Message 1: Apps Script + checkout
exactPrompt.content:
Ab checkout banao. Customer form bharega aur "Order on WhatsApp" dabayega. Do kaam hone chahiye:
    1. Order mere Google Sheet ke "orders" tab mein nayi row mein save ho (status: New)
  2. WhatsApp khule, poora order message ready ho (Order ID ke saath)

  Mujhe do:
  - Google Apps Script ka Code.gs (orders tab mein row add kare) aur deploy karne ke steps
  - checkout.html (form: naam, WhatsApp number, address, city, pincode, payment: UPI ya Cash on Delivery, notes)
  - config.js mein teesri line orders web app link ke liye
  - Purani app.js ka poora code replace karo, style.css bhi update
  - Form check kare: galat number ya khaali field par message dikhe
  - Order ke baad website par Thank You page (Order ID aur summary ke saath)
